name: goku
description: Dragon Ball orange theme for Claude: light and dark, mountain backdrop, Goku on the Flying Nimbus, power level from context usage, Dragon Balls and Shenron.

frame.title: Backdrop rendering
frame.description: image = draw the backdrop as an image (default); sandbox = draw it in a sandboxed frame. Try sandbox if animations stand still (for example on macOS).

motion.title: Animations
motion.description: system = respect the operating system's Reduce motion setting (animations freeze when it is on); always = animate regardless.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: on = play event sounds; off = silent (toasts still show). Per session: /sound-kinto.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of in-app texts (toasts, captions, bar, command replies).

threshold1.title: Power level 1 threshold (%)
threshold1.description: First power level (sound, toast, bar flash).

threshold4.title: Power level 4 threshold (%)
threshold4.description: Fourth power level; from here the bar adds 'over 9000!'.

ssjThreshold.title: Super Saiyan from (%)
ssjThreshold.description: Context usage at which Super Saiyan starts (gold bar, aura, glowing backdrop).
